review: 701.29a-1: the base variant carried a non-empty delta; moved its choice (Hill Giant to the bottom) into decisions and emptied the delta

scenarios.title: Fateseal looks at the top of an opponent's library and moves the chosen card to the bottom or leaves it on top

setup.notes: Library lists are ordered top first. Mesmeric Sliver gives every Sliver 'When this permanent enters, you may fateseal 1'.

decisions: A casts Mesmeric Sliver, tapping four Islands.
Both players pass; it resolves and enters, and its enters trigger goes on the stack with A choosing to fateseal 1.
The trigger resolves: A looks at the top card of B's library (Hill Giant) and puts it on the bottom of B's library.

variants.label: bottom
variants.expected: B's library from the top is Grizzly Bears, Forest, Hill Giant.

variants.label: top
variants.delta: A leaves Hill Giant on top of B's library.
variants.expected: B's library from the top is Hill Giant, Grizzly Bears, Forest.

variants.label: declined
variants.delta: A chooses not to fateseal when the trigger resolves.
variants.expected: B's library from the top is Hill Giant, Grizzly Bears, Forest and A looks at no card.

scenarios.forge_notes: Only Mesmeric Sliver fatesealed in Forge's cardsfolder, and only for N=1.
